استلزموا (form X)
# اِسْتَلْزَمُوا (istalzamū) /is.tal.za.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اُسْتُلْزِمُوا (ustulzimū) /us.tul.zi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اِسْتَلْزِمُوا (istalzimū) /is.tal.zi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
